{{Conjecture|legends}}
When the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] flew over the dangerous [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in an [[Explorer craft]] in search of his missing son, [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]], he flew over a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]], and an orange creauture on a tree branch above the Explorer craft snarled at it as it flew by. Most of the creature's body was covered with orange fur, although it had some black stripes along its back. It also had yellow eyes, long claws, sharp teeth, and a very long tail.<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook">''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The creature appeared to have been drawn with both feline and canine characteristics.<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook"/>
